svg.title: AuditWeaver - AI-powered log security platform
svg.desc: Distributed Nginx logs pass through Kafka and Logstash to rule detection, independent hot and archive storage workers, and Dify analysis. Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, MySQL and Redis support the shared log query layer, FastAPI LangGraph Agent, Django backend and Next.js analyst workspace.

g.text: AI-powered log analysis and security investigation
Collect logs, normalize fields and detect known attacks
Log archive, hot search, application records and cache
Raw logs + rule events -> ES / CK
FULL ARCHIVE: raw logs + rule events
Every record is archived on arrival
Shared by Django and MCP tools
MCP tools / RAG retrieval + case sync
Hybrid capability shown. ES hot window: 168 hours by event time. ClickHouse archives all records immediately.
